_about.readMe: Claude Code settings that go well with the system. The installer never writes these; copy what you want into ~/.claude/settings.json. Remove "_about" when you do.
_about.attribution: Empty strings: no AI attribution in commits and pull requests (the style pack's guard denies it anyway).
_about.autoCompactWindow: A compact keeps a small part of the conversation, so a larger window compacts less often. The resume point survives it either way.
_about.permissions.allow: Reads and everyday steps that need no prompt. Guards still see every one of them.
_about.permissions.ask: Git and ripgrep options that skip hooks, run another program or write a file always ask, even where the plain command is allowed.
_about.autoMode.allow: For auto mode only, and optional: lets a merge through when you asked for it or /land's gate passed. The merge gate still checks the review and CI. Leave it out to be asked about every merge.

allow: gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit of a pull request the user asked to land, or one whose /land gate record in ~/.claude/coordination says every check passed
